## Fixed
- **Screenshots from your coding tools now reach the model.** Agent apps such as GitHub Copilot hand a tool's screenshot back to the model inside the tool's result. Astronomical used to refuse that on the Responses endpoint ("function_call_output is unsupported") and quietly drop the picture on Chat Completions. Now the model sees it, on every endpoint, so a vision model can look at the page your agent just captured. In GitHub Copilot, tick "Supports image input" for the model in Settings → Model providers. - A clearer error when an image in a request names a stored file or has no image in it.
## Under the hood
- Test comments brought up to date with the code.
## Compatibility
- Apple silicon Macs with macOS 14 or later. - Your settings, models and conversations carry over unchanged. - A model that only reads text still declines images, now including images a tool returns.
Astronomical is signed with a Developer ID, notarized by Apple, and delivered as a signed Sparkle update.
